title: Binary Search
statement: `nums` is sorted ascending and contains distinct values. Return the index of `target`, or -1 when it is absent.
hints: Keep a closed interval [lo, hi] of indices that might still hold the target.
Compare the middle element and discard the half that cannot contain it.
Loop while lo <= hi. Returning on an empty interval means the target is absent.

approaches.name: Binary search
approaches.explanation: Halve the closed interval each step.

editorial: Set lo to 0 and hi to n - 1. While the interval is nonempty, let mid = (lo + hi) // 2. Equality returns mid. A smaller target moves hi to mid - 1. A larger target moves lo to mid + 1. Using mid + 1 and mid - 1 is what guarantees the interval shrinks, including when mid equals lo.
